Update reuse adds changed-ID lookups during traversal and up to1024 candidate owners; the cap can return queries to the existing full exact scan until maintenance. It also conservatively counts nonembedded changed chunks.

An old base pins its old document allocations until eviction/rebuild or captured queries finish. Live queries never rank changed base rows. Existing running-worker permit ownership bounds admission, not process RSS.
